items.title: EMCOR Group (EME) Stock Still Looks Cheap As Its Five Year Run Continues
items.summary: EMCOR Group has turned a long run in its share price into a talking point, and the question now is whether the current valuation is properly grounded in the cash the business generates. With the stock up sharply over recent years, investors are increasingly asking if the present price still lines up with its underlying cash flows. Over the past 5 years, EMCOR Group has delivered a very large total return, so any fresh buyer today needs to think carefully about what cash flow profile is now...
